responseCodes.col_1: PUT https://developer.api.autodesk.com/oss/v2/signedresources/{hash}
App only
data:write
JSON
Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is a two-legged access token obtained via a Client Credentials Grant flow.
The MIME type of the object to upload; can be any type except ‘multipart/form-data’. This can be omitted, but we recommend adding it.
The size of the data contained in the request body, in bytes.
The suggested file name to use when this object is downloaded as a file.

Specifies where the bucket containing the object is stored. Possible values are:

US - (Default) Data center for the US region.
EMEA - Data center for the European Union, Middle East, and Africa.
AUS - Data center for Australia.
CAN - Data center for the Canada region.
DEU - Data center for the Germany region.
IND - Data center for the India region.
JPN - Data center for the Japan region.
GBR - Data center for the United Kingdom region.

The current value of the sha1 attribute of the object you want to replace. OSS checks the If-Match header against the sha1 attribute of the object in OSS. If they match, OSS allows the object to be overwritten. Otherwise, it means that the object on OSS has been modified since you retrieved the sha1 and the request fails.

The ID component of the signed URL.
Note: The signed URL returned by Generate Signed OSS URL contains hash as a URI parameter.
The object to upload.
The object was successfully replaced.

The supplied authorization header was not valid or the supplied token scope was not acceptable. Verify authentication and try again.

The bucket key of the bucket that contains the object.
An identifier (URN) that uniquely and persistently identifies the object.
A URL-encoded human-friendly name that identifies the object.
A hash value computed from the data of the object.
The total amount of storage space occupied by the object, in bytes.
The format of the data stored within the object, expressed as a MIME type.
A URL that points to the actual location of the object.
